cost_identity_rule: Build CPU uses round(seconds*1e9) canonical integer nanoseconds; source/artifact hashes, shapes, seeds, counts, model digests and reference are exact. Actual budget caps are never rounded or relaxed.
cost_scope: Metadata preflight R&D only, retained separately; no measurement or budget credit.

protocol.authorization: Parent explicitly authorized H4 and the technical-only startup-recovery principle after H2/H3 zero-result failures; same36design/inputs/order/budgets/scorer required.

budgets.scope: entire R&D worker plus own children/startup/imports/input reconstruction/artifact reads/content checks/all service calls/observers/final persistence; launcher overhead separately retained and counted in total R&D guard

content_check.N_full: compute actual decoded raw expected utility for every TRAIN row and retain all three seed arrays
content_check.free_label_oracle_raw: mean(max(NC_full, NC_low)); report difference from mean(N_full)
content_check.free_label_oracle_scope: No timing assumption; empirical raw-utility ceiling only for this TRAIN batch and these two fixed NC potential content actions with free outcome labels, not a full-lifecycle net bound or impossibility result for other models/architectures/actions/samples
content_check.no_repair: any identity/numerical mismatch fails; do not relax tolerance or replace checkpoints
content_check.observer: frozen decoded-output raw utility with reconstructed TRAIN labels, outside service timers but inside total R&D budget

cost.assumption: oracle max(g-c,0) assumes fixed additive marginal proxy; aggregate measured cost is not per-row oracle latency or an unconditional CPU upper bound
cost.historical_build: include old whole-system build/(3H) once in conditional comparisons; gross critic/helper already lies in NC build, never add twice
cost.mandatory_overhead: retain NC-go versus same-NC direct-full service+preparation contrast and content D=mean(N_full-NC_full); do not silently equate separately computed medians with median paired differences
cost.new_marginal_cpu_ns: per seed median of three signed (NC-go service CPU minus NC-stop service CPU)/3072; retain signed values, then clamp median below at zero
cost.old_H1: keep historical H1 prices/results immutable; new simultaneous-wave prices are separately named H3 values, not a retroactive correction
cost.preparation: retain per-path per-repeat preparation CPU separately and include preparation/H in complete comparisons; exclude preparation from the marginal service estimator only
cost.sensitivity: retain signed marginal-price sensitivity before zero clamp and all three raw paired observations; median additivity/mixture assumptions mean the oracle is not a strict complete-CPU upper bound

dataset.persistence: save full pixels/instruction tensor, labels, source IDs and input hashes once; no validation/test construction
dataset.reuse: reuse Q1 per-row NC full/low/g/OOF predictions and identities after equivalence checks, no new OOF fit

failure_accounting.known_settled_units: lower bound on total declared charged units if a partial private measure ledger cannot be returned
failure_accounting.reporting: set accounting_incomplete=true on missing partial measure; retain original failure, known lower bound, unsettled quote/scope and missing information; if no valid finite upper bound is recoverable, state this explicitly; never claim a complete ledger or successful cap verification
failure_accounting.terminal: any such failure stops H3 and consumes START without retry
failure_accounting.unsettled_quote_units: upper bound on additional unsettled units from its scoped preflight quote, not executed/settled work

protocol.failure_policy: exclusive fixed START before reconstruction; any exception, cap breach, mismatch or interrupted/partial run is terminal, persist original error/partial costs, no retry or new output alias

numerical_tolerance.historical_seconds_normalization: round(seconds*1e9) on both compared CPU receipts, the source timer precision; not a gate tolerance

identity_semantics.strict_budgets: Actual H4 CPU>30s, actual work>4B, retained bytes>32MiB remain failures. No rounding/tolerance bypass for real budget breaches.

native_library.reuse: existing T11 artifact for separate R&D only; no compilation and no credit to any build

protocol.pre_START_revision: New separately authorized H3 identity after retained H2 zero-measurement startup failure; exact same scientific sample/order/cost/evidence/budget/stopping design as final H2, no H2 lock reset

prior_H2_failure.retention: H2 locks, freeze, failure and costs stay sealed; H3 does not resume/reset H2 and never selects among measured outcomes
prior_H2_failure.status: terminal startup implementation failure; zero TRAIN/model/service measurements; not a scientific effect estimate

prior_H3_failure.cost_identity: Historical phase CPU floats compare after round(seconds*1e9); NC8537556029 and N8307966292 unchanged. All true budgets remain exact/unrelaxed.
prior_H3_failure.failure: ValueError: historical complete build cost changed; exact binary float equality falsely rejected identical integer-nanosecond values

recovery_authorization.budget: H3 retains the same fresh 30CPU-second/4B-unit/32MiB diagnostic bounds, not the unapproved reduced-budget recovery draft; separately retain H2 cost 0.519258463 seconds plus H3 actual and preflight R&D in cumulative reporting
recovery_authorization.precondition: freeze committed repair/runtime/protocol identity and pass actual shared dependency-import/WorkLedger --startup-smoke without dataset/artifact/model/native/service execution before the sole H3 wave
recovery_authorization.runtime_reuse: reuse training_diagnostics/dynamic-h2/run_once.py and analyze.py; fixed --experiment h3 selects only H3 stage/output/freeze/schema/arm identity; no new training or analysis engine
recovery_authorization.scientific_execution_repair: remove invalid ampersand from WorkLedger label; accounting grammar/prices/rules unchanged
recovery_authorization.scope: Parent explicitly authorized one separately registered H3 after the H2 zero-measurement invalid-arm failure, following legal-label repair and real import/startup no-data smoke.

protocol.runtime_binding: training_diagnostics/dynamic-h3/frozen-h3.json must bind committed protocol_sha256, source_commit, complete shared runtime sources, shared H2 run_once.py script_sha256 and shared H2 analyze.py analysis_sha256; root supplies hashes before execution
scope_limits: only selected T11 NDU/full necessary comparison, not an exhaustive best-static menu proof
old rowwise profile only; no codec-D1 normalization, source repair, retry or outcome replacement
TRAIN encoder already trained and checkpoint validation-selected; no independent generalization inference
no fitting, threshold/lambda/rho search, training, validation metric extraction, formal data or new qualification
D1 hard-stop slot0 failure remains final; H3 is a separately registered diagnostic

service.N-full: selected static NDU weights, direct full, no unused low encoder/critic
service.NC-full: same NC weights, direct full, no unused low encoder/critic
service.NC-go: same NC weights and original fitted MSE controller, force continue while charging real low/critic/full
service.NC-stop: same NC weights and original fitted MSE controller, force stop while charging real low/critic

output_retention.sampled_output: first actual sampled PNG/JSON per completed call only
output_retention.timing_scope: retain original batch/preparation allocation scope; not independent per-row timing measurements

service.paired_sampling: same sample seed for all four paths within each seed/repeat
service.path_order: left rotate base paths by (repeat + seed_index) modulo 4; seed_index follows model_seeds
service.per_call_preparation: fresh complete generator/controller setup; record and charge preparation then all actual sampled caption/PNG/hash/base64/JSON/output-ledger service; no output/codec cache or warmup
service.retention: retain all three raw observations, negative increments, outliers and exact order; each completed call retains only its first actual PNG/JSON sampled_output plus all 3072-row work/cpu/output_bytes vectors, batch/preparation vectors and original receipts and sample seed; no timing CI or best-of selection

protocol.status: protocol-only; no execution until committed source/protocol/freeze review
protocol.technical_repair_policy: Retain every failed instance and actual R&D cost. Before any measurement/model result is observed, pure startup/import/serialization defects may be repaired under a new technical identity without asking again; never resume/delete an old START. Once results start, stop under the fixed failure policy; no selective reruns.
